prompt_head:
Role: Forward Deployed Engineer (Fort Lauderdale/Miami) at TribalScale
<requirements>
[r1] (required, other) Professional experience building and deploying prod

assessments.note: Built and deployed AI agents and full-stack platforms.
Proficient in Python and TypeScript, used in multiple projects.
Worked with LangGraph orchestration and state‑machine style workflows.
Applied LLM evaluation frameworks in AI projects.
Demonstrated prompt engineering and structured output design.
Implemented Langfuse tracing for AI decision observability.
Delivered FastAPI service with Postgres, Docker, CI/CD.
Rapidly built unfamiliar AI systems as shown in summaries.
Created prototypes and production agents from ambiguous specs.
Handled human‑in‑the‑loop reviews, indicating product trade‑off awareness.
Communicated AI system details in summaries and documentation.
No evidence of travel capability provided.
Based in Weston, FL, within the Fort Lauderdale/Miami area.
Collaborated with clients and teams on CRM integrations.

output.verdict_line: The candidate broadly meets the technical and soft‑skill requirements, with minor gaps in travel readiness and demonstrated product judgment.
top_gaps: Explicit communication of AI system behavior
